notes.title: Performance Update
notes.content:
- Increase in frame rates to allow smoother game-play. 

- Update to Thumb-stick/thumb-pad controls to allow rotation with the right motion controller. 

- Trigger now fully controls pick-up/drop mechanic. 

- Grip buttons now trigger finger guns. 

- Default player height decreased. 

- Environment and lighting updated. 

- Enemy AI speed decreased. 

- Gun drop mechanic now changed so player must touch the gun to the belt, to holster it, in order to drop.  

- New creeps and scares.

notes.title: Big Update 10/2/2018
notes.content:
****************************************************************************************
                             Patch notes - Multiple Bugs fixes
****************************************************************************************


-Lighting update - There are differences with lighting between the Vive and Occulus HMD so we kept putting on each headset and adjusted the lighting in our levels until they looked pretty darn close.

-New spooks and scares - Couple more hoots and a few more spooky boi’s. Watch out. 

-Main menu update - We added a forest with some mist instead of a blank area.

-Items now snap to belt for better organization. Before you could just pile all items in one spot and it was difficult to get to items so we made snapping for items. Now it will groups keys, bullets and other repeat objects together for easier management.

-Once you’ve stepped off the dock, the player can return to the boat and leave whenever you like. There are different endings based on how far you’ve progressed in the game.

-Monster mechanics and AI update (even scarier than before)

-Cabin interior gets creepier each time the player returns to the cabin. We want the feeling and atmosphere to get creepier as the game goes on.

-Some of the keys and chests have been placed in new locations. If you have previously played we have changed it up a bit to keep you on your toes.

-The forest has newly added content - Before it was just a regular ole forest. Now it’s home to some other mysterious things. Some curious stuff hidden out there and another puzzle with a new item!

-Tree meshes/textures have been updated  

-Books have been updated with new hints and lore. Easier to read.

-Option to skip can now be accessed by pressing the pause button during the opening cut scene

Let us know if you would like to see more update. Thanks For Playing

Visit us www.treefort.me Reddit: r/allthevr

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Thank-you everyone for your patronage and patience.This new update should
make your experience even better. 
 
- The player can now skip the opening cut scene by pressing the  pause button.
-Oculus users can now crouch by pressing in the thumb-stick.
-We fixed multiple small little bugs. 
-And did more optimization to the scene for increased fps and smoother game-play.

Stay tuned, 
let us know what else you would like to see and how we can make the game even better. 


The Treefort Team

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Update 8/28/2018

Thanks to everyone who has played the game so far and for all of your feedback. 

-Player is always located in proper position for cut scenes  

-There has been an update to environment lighting 

-Releasing the trigger now lets go of doors and drawers as well as lets go while climbing

-Interactive objects no longer collide with environment 

-Lazer pointer added to start menu controller to make selecting buttons easier

-Oculus controller now added to start menu  and Oculus controller instructions added if player is using a rift

-Start menu is now proper height for Oculus

-Oculus users can now pause the game.

-Button added to pause screen so player can quit to main menu

-Standard melee weapons now have same effect on Enemy AI as the gun.
